description: Election Commission - T. H. Kularathne was elected as the member of the Bope-Poddala P/S
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Bope-Poddala Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member ceasing to belong to their political party. It involves the electoral process under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, including the nomination and declaration of a new elected member. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it deals with electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of elected members for local government positions.
